name: Tooltip
summary: A short, transient hint shown on hover or focus of its trigger.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tooltip text="…"> — wraps a trigger and shows the shared dark-navy bubble (with an arrow) on hover/focus. Defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue; shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. This is the single shared tooltip the settings pattern's ? help glyph references. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Bubble
spec.value: dark-navy #1A1A2E (or brand #6A1EBB), white text, radius 6, padding 6 10

spec.label: Arrow
spec.value: anchored to the trigger, matches the fill; `arrow=false` hides it

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: top (default) · bottom · left · right centred, PLUS 8 edge-aligned (top-start/-end, bottom-start/-end, left-start/-end, right-start/-end) — same side, aligned to the trigger edge with the arrow offset near it

spec.label: Trigger
spec.value: hover + focus (default) · focus · click (toggle, Esc/click-away to close); `open` forces it visible

spec.label: a11y
spec.value: role=tooltip, aria-describedby wired to the slotted trigger, shows on focus, no leaked listeners

props.name: text
props.desc: The hint text shown in the bubble

props.name: placement
props.desc: Which side of the trigger the bubble + arrow sit on. The 4 cardinal values centre the bubble; the 8 edge-aligned values (…-start / …-end) align it to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow offset near that edge (AntD naming)

props.name: color
props.desc: Bubble fill: dark-navy #1A1A2E or brand color-primary #6A1EBB

props.name: arrow
props.desc: Show the caret pointing at the trigger; arrow="false" hides it

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How it opens: hover+focus · focus only · click to toggle

props.name: open
props.desc: Force the bubble visible (demos/tests); otherwise the trigger opens it

whenToUse.when: a brief, non-essential hint — an icon-only button's name, a ? help elaboration
a must-see consequence that is hard to undo — put it inline, not in a tooltip
richer content or interactive controls — a tooltip is text only

opinion.note: Never hide essential information in a tooltip — it is unavailable on touch and to keyboard users who don't focus the trigger. Keep it to a short phrase; the trigger must be focusable.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 / AntD Tooltip matrix: `placement` now ships the FULL 12-placement set — the 4 cardinal sides (top/bottom/left/right, centred) PLUS the 8 edge-aligned ones (top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, left-start, left-end, right-start, right-end — same side, aligned to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow offset near that edge, AntD naming) — a `title` (our `text`), a `color` (default dark vs a brand fill), an `arrow` on/off, and `trigger` (hover/focus/click). All ship on the element. The measured DS V3 `tooltip|card` cell is a distinct rich 260px info CARD (white text, 16px padding, an icon) — a popover, not this simple text hint — and remains a separate future component. This `aha-tooltip` is the dark-navy hint bubble the settings skill's `?` help tooltip points to; spec derived from that convention + tokens (bg-dark, color-primary, text-inverse, radius-sm, 12/18). Motion is the shared .2s ease-out pop on a PERSISTENT node (class/attr toggle, never a subtree rebuild — the historic MOTION_DEBT trap is clean).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: placement top/bottom/left/right + arrow toggle + brand fill
click trigger toggles + closes on Esc/click-away, no leaked listeners

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe uses `open` so the bubble is in layout and measurable.
